metrics_finding.finding: The user-service experienced a significant increase in CPU utilization during the failure window, from 0.0099 to 0.6693366666666667, and a decrease in mean latency from 0.292 to 0.038.

evidence_summary.summary: The user-service experienced a significant increase in CPU utilization and a decrease in mean latency, indicating a potential performance issue.

report.suggested_fix: Investigate and optimize the user-service for improved performance.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be related to a performance issue in the user-service. Further investigation is required to confirm this hypothesis.
report_text.hi: अप्रत्याशित घटना के पीछे मुख्य कारण संभवतः उपयोगकर्ति-सेवा में प्रदर्शन समस्या है। अतिरिक्त जांच आवश्यक है ताकि यह सिद्ध किया जा सके।
